title: School Web Applications (2014 - Present)
subtitle: Javascript, Canvas, JQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Ajax, PHP, JSON, AWS (CloudFront, EC2, Ubuntu, SimpleDB)
text: From 2014 - 2016 I ported all Hydra-Gen school programs from Java Applet to HTML5 due to the browser war on Java. Engine life-cycles are getting shorter as technology advances; thus, I made sure to greatly simplify this engine to it's core basics.
